rulings.restated: Enter the amount from helper "Deduction before income limits for this item or group of similar items across all donees, after required valuation/basis reductions".
rulings.model: Copying the deduction amount is correct. However, no refusal covers a case the text sends to Section B below $5,000: 'You must file Form 8283, Section B, if you are contributing a single article of clothing or household item that is not in good used condition or better and for which you are claiming a deduction of over $500.' The program would go ahead in that case without naming the exclusion.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: second reading right; data changed under BUG-0010. Form 8283 Section B is also required for "a single article of clothing or household item that is not in good used condition or better and for which you are claiming a deduction of over $500" (i8283 p. 3); the screen `gift.special` did not name that case. It now does, so such an item is refused; the line itself is unchanged.
